2607.08208.title: Diarization-Guided Qwen-ASR Adaptation for Multilingual Two-Speaker Conversational Speech
2607.08208.paper_summary: This paper describes our self-designed system for Task 1 of the MLC-SLM 2026 Challenge for multilingual two-speaker conversational speech. The system combines a modular speaker diarization front end with a challenge-adapted Qwen3-ASR-1.7B recognizer. The diarization front end performs voice activity detection, subsegment generation, CAMPPlus speaker embedding extraction, two-speaker spectral clustering, and RTTM-based audio segmentation. The resulting speaker-attributed segments are grouped by language or region and decoded by the adapted ASR model. For ASR adaptation, we first perform supervised full fine-tuning on the official training data, then apply LoRA fine-tuning with synthetic speech generated by a three-pipeline TTS-based synthetic speech augmentation framework, and finally refine the model using GRPO reinforcement learning with rewards based on WER/CER and penalties for hallucination, repetition, and length deviation. On the official development set, the full system achieves an average tcpMER of 23.70, reducing the error rate by 6.83 absolute points relative to the released Qwen-ASR-1.7B performance. On the final evaluation set, the system achieves an average tcpMER of 17.97. Ablation results show that supervised fine-tuning provides the largest gain, while synthetic-speech LoRA adaptation and reinforcement learning further improve robustness.
2607.08208.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文描述了我們為MLC-SLM 2026挑戰賽的任務1自設計的系統，該挑戰賽針對多語言雙語者對話語音。該系統結合了模組化的說話者區分前端和適應挑戰的Qwen3-ASR-1.7B識別器。區分前端執行語音活動檢測、子段生成、CAMPPlus說話者嵌入提取、雙說話者頻譜聚類以及基於RTTM的音頻分割。生成的說話者屬性段根據語言或地區進行分組，並由適應的ASR模型解碼。對於ASR適應，我們首先在官方訓練數據上執行有監督的完整微調，然後應用LoRA微調，使用由三管道TTS基礎的合成語音增強框架生成的合成語音，最後使用基於WER/CER的獎勵和對幻覺、重複及長度偏差的懲罰進行GRPO強化學習來精煉模型。在官方開發集上，完整系統達到了23.70的平均tcpMER，相較於釋出的Qwen-ASR-1.7B性能，降低了6.83個絕對點的錯誤率。在最終評估集上，系統達到了17.97的平均tcpMER。消融結果顯示，有監督的微調提供了最大的增益，而合成語音的LoRA適應和強化學習進一步提高了穩健性。
